link_answers.reason: Showing SQL is about displaying a query, while running a SELECT is about executing it; neither action necessarily implies the other.
Showing SQL is a display action, and running a mutation is an execution action; one can happen without the other, and neither implies the other.
A mutation query is not a SELECT query, so running a mutation means not running a SELECT in the same action.
